key_finding: The actual iter_014 submission (LGB-only + T83 thresh) is essentially iter_013 with marginally different thresholds (+0.07 LOSO). Four experiments (T81 NN, T87 SPO+ DFL, T86 quantile, T95 GRU) have proven LOSO lifts of +2-4 over iter_014 but were not incorporated. The fastest path to iter_015 uses T87 NPZ + T86 quantile models (already trained, zero GPU needed) for estimated +1.4-2.1 platform lift.
